actual: R12P child backtests first fail with OSError WinError 1920 while scanning child workspace bak_basic.h5; after filtering WSL factor symlinks, the 16.9MB combined_prediction.pkl would exceed the 10MB qe_file_sync per-file limit.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Remote combine small-file packaging dereferences DrvFS Linux factor symlinks before filtering them and incorrectly routes the large combined prediction through the 10MB small-file channel instead of the existing content-addressed Artifact Store.
expected: Filter dataset artifacts by name and suffix before any Windows stat/dereference; send only declared runtime files through qe_file_sync; publish combined_prediction.pkl through the content-addressed Artifact Store and link it in the remote workspace.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
title: QE remote combine small-file scan dereferences WSL factor symlinks
